candidate_windows.window_text: The biased model, which consists of a single fully connected layer, is trained using the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 5e-4 and for 3 epochs. BERT-based models, including baseline, UMS, and debiased models, are trained using the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 2.5e-5 and for 3 epochs on 4 Nvidia Volta v100 GPU. The batch size is 128 for every model. We train and evaluate 10 times for each model and calculate mean and standard deviation. For each model, a checkpoint that shows the best performance in the real environment is selected for performance measure.
